subdomain.name: Telemetry Ingestion & Processing
subdomain.capability: Continuous, high-throughput ingestion of raw 1Hz time-series sensor payloads (heart rate, power, cadence, ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke telemetry) from IoT edge devices, bike computers and smart wearables; enforces Sensor Metric Boundaries, reconciles out-of-order backfills and buffers windowed telemetry streams for streaming analytics (PulseStream Engine).
subdomain.why_distinct: Core component of the endurance athletic analytics platform with its own language (t_device vs t_ingress, Backfill Reorder Window), its own rules (boundary validation, reordering, append-only revisions) and a reactive backpressure-driven cadence distinct from downstream analytics.

ubiquitous_language.definition: Individual 1Hz data point of a sensor metric.
Raw payload received from an edge device carrying Telemetry Samples.
Device-generated epoch timestamp; the chronological ordering key.
Arrival time at the ingestion entry point; never used for ordering.
60-second window within which delayed out-of-order packets are re-indexed chronologically.
Physical physiological/mechanical constraint a metric must satisfy (e.g. HR 30-240 BPM).
Status flag tagged on samples violating a Sensor Metric Boundary; payload is kept.
Demand-signalling control keeping the ingestion entry point non-blocking under burst load.
Appended record representing a corrective or backfilled frame; raw records are never mutated.
Sliding-window buffered stream of validated telemetry offered to streaming analytics and downstream event streams.

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Ingestion & Validation
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Accept Ingress Packets, validate Telemetry Samples against Sensor Metric Boundaries, reorder by t_device within the Backfill Reorder Window, and persist append-only raw records and revisions.
in_scope: 1Hz sample ingestion for heart rate, power, cadence, ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke telemetry
Backfill reordering by t_device within 60 seconds
Backpressure at the ingestion entry point
invariants: Every Telemetry Sample is validated against its Sensor Metric Boundary (HR: 30-240 BPM, Power: 0-2500W, Cadence: 0-220 RPM, Swimming Pace: >45 sec/100m) before downstream propagation
Invalid samples are tagged VALIDATION_FAILED and the underlying payload is never dropped
Packets delayed up to 60 seconds are ordered by t_device, not t_ingress
Ingestion entry point applies reactive backpressure with zero blocking I/O on thread pools
Raw time-series records are strictly append-only; corrections and backfills append new Event Revisions
source_of_truth: Raw telemetry records and their Event Revisions

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Stream Distribution
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Buffer validated telemetry into sliding-window streams and broadcast them with backpressure awareness to downstream event streams and streaming analytics.
in_scope: Real-time metrics backfilling propagation to consumers
invariants: Broadcast honours downstream backpressure and does not block
Only samples already validated by Telemetry Ingestion & Validation are propagated

assumptions.item: Split into ingestion/validation and stream distribution contexts because the description names windowed buffering and broadcasting as a distinct cadence and consumer; description itself calls it a single domain focus.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Could merge into one context if buffering shares consistency with storage.

assumptions.item: Transport posture: delivery from edge devices is not stated. Likely at-least-once (retries), yet append-only revisions need an identity distinguishing a retry from a new event. Candidate natural identity (device, metric, t_device): is the mutable payload value part of it or excluded, and what then separates a retry from a legitimate correction? Alternatives: client-supplied key, or accept duplicates.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Determines dedup duty of the ingestion context and whether corrections become no-op duplicates.

assumptions.item: Unbounded quantities (collected list): ground contact time, respiration and swim stroke telemetry have no named ranges; Swimming Pace has only a lower bound (>45 sec/100m) and no upper bound. No range invented; posture is unbounded/validation disabled pending operator answer.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Affects completeness of Sensor Metric Boundary invariant ownership, not context split.

assumptions.item: Samples arriving later than the 60-second Backfill Reorder Window are undefined by the description; handling (reject, append as revision, flag) is unspecified.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Ownership stays in ingestion context; outcome affects revision rules.

assumptions.item: Sliding-window size and the relationship between 'sliding-window validation' and the 60-second reorder window are not specified.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Validation might partly belong to the distribution context if windowed.
